charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Take control of a base in any matchmaking Strongholds game.

forced_annexation.name: Forced Annexation
forced_annexation.description: Take control of 3 bases without dying in any matchmaking Strongholds game.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.description: Earn any assist medal in Warzone.

bulldozer.name: Bulldozer
bulldozer.description: Finish any matchmaking Slayer game with a KDA above 8.

flag_defender.name: Flag Defender
flag_defender.description: Protect your team's flag in any matchmaking Capture the Flag game.

got_you.name: Got You!
got_you.description: Return your team's flag in any matchmaking Capture the Flag game.

stakeholder.name: Stakeholder
stakeholder.description: Defend a base belonging to your team in any matchmaking Strongholds game.

flag_carrier_hunter.name: Flag Carrier Hunter
flag_carrier_hunter.description: Kill an enemy flag carrier in any matchmaking Capture the Flag game.

flag_victory.name: Flag Victory
flag_victory.description: Win any matchmaking Capture the Flag game.

splatter.name: Splatter
splatter.description: Splatter an enemy Spartan with a vehicle.

spartan_carnage.name: Spartan Carnage
spartan_carnage.description: Kill multiple enemy Spartans without dying.

melee_fighter.name: Melee Fighter
melee_fighter.description: Kill an enemy Spartan with a melee attack.

headshot.name: Headshot
headshot.description: Kill an enemy Spartan with a headshot.

eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
eagle_eye.description: Kill a full-health enemy Spartan with a precision weapon without missing a single shot.

flag_em_down.name: Flag 'Em Down
flag_em_down.description: Earn one of the following medals: Interception, Flag Joust, Carrier Kill, Flag Return, Flag Defense

im_just_perfect.name: I'm Just Perfect
im_just_perfect.description: Kill a player with a precision weapon without missing a shot

lawnmower.name: Lawnmower
lawnmower.description: Kill an opponent by running them over with a vehicle

look_ma_no_pin.name: Look Ma, No Pin
look_ma_no_pin.description: Kill an enemy Spartan with any grenade

lucky.name: Lucky

positive_contribution.name: Positive Contribution

power_play.name: Power Play
power_play.description: Kill an enemy Spartan with a power weapon

road_trip.name: Road Trip
road_trip.description: Kill an enemy Spartan with a ground vehicle

sting_like_a_bee.name: Sting Like a Bee
sting_like_a_bee.description: Kill an enemy Spartan in close combat

the_reaper.name: The Reaper
the_reaper.description: Kill an opponent from beyond the grave

too_fast_for_you.name: Too Fast For You
too_fast_for_you.description: Kill an opponent who shot you first

like_a_boss.name: Like a Boss
like_a_boss.description: Kill a boss in a Firefight Warzone game
